## MSVC linker not found (VS 2026 / version 18 Insiders)
- **Error**: `link.exe` not found for `x86_64-pc-windows-msvc` target
- **Cause**: VS 2026 (version 18 Insiders) installs MSVC at `C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\18\Insiders\VC\Tools\MSVC\14.52.36418\` — non-standard path, not auto-discovered by rustc
- **Fix**: Added to `.cargo/config.toml`:
  - `[target.x86_64-pc-windows-msvc]` section with explicit `linker` path
  - `[env]` with `INCLUDE` and `LIB` pointing to MSVC include/lib dirs
- **Result**: Build succeeded in 52.22s

## Project identity
- Name: Tensor-Engine (tensor_engine v0.3.2)
- Rust 1.95.0, edition 2021, host: x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
- Features: python_bindings, openblas, safetensors, tokenizers, vision, audio, async_ops
- Dependencies: ndarray, pyo3, rayon, wgpu, cudarc, rocket, actix-web, tokenizers, safetensors
- BLAS: OpenBLAS (prebuilt in OpenBLAS-0.3.30-x64-64)
